# Aawej Pathan

> Hey, I'm Aawej — I build AI stuff that excites me. I'm a 16-year-old AI engineer and technical builder. My main project is AgentOnboard, an identity layer that gives every AI agent its own ID card. I also built RankGeo, and I ship everything in public on GitHub. This site is my portfolio and writing home.

I started coding because I wanted to build things that feel alive. When LLMs got good, I realized anyone could build production-grade AI systems from a bedroom — so I stopped writing simple scripts and started designing agent architectures and the tooling around them. I build in the open and document what I learn.

Important notes:

- AgentOnboard is a separate live product at https://ao.aawej.in, not part of this portfolio codebase.
- The whole idea behind AgentOnboard: agents should have their own identity, not borrow yours. You save a static key once with `aon save`, agents exchange it for short-lived session tokens, and services verify through AgentOnboard — they never see a static key.
- This site is my portfolio and blog, built with Next.js. Here's where you'll find my work, my writing, and how to reach me.

## Work

- [Work](https://aawej.in/work): Everything I'm building — AgentOnboard, RankGeo, openwts, and Developer.
- [AgentOnboard](https://aawej.in/work/agentonboard): Identity for AI agents. My main build.
- [RankGeo](https://aawej.in/work/rankgeo): Generative Engine Optimization — how ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini see your brand.
- [openwts](https://aawej.in/work/openwts): A CLI that wraps git worktrees around AI coding agents so every task gets its own clean room.
- [Developer](https://aawej.in/work/developer): My Claude Code-style terminal agent with an Ink TUI, wired to 500+ LLMs.
